title: Buck converter cooling chain
description:
Design the cooling for a synchronous buck converter: Vin = 24 V, Vout = 5 V, Iout = 15 A. Both MOSFETs are identical: Rds(on) = 6.31 mOhm at 25 C with temperature coefficient alpha = 0.0042 per C, i.e. Rds(Tj) = Rds25 * (1 + alpha * (Tj - 25)); switching transition tr + tf = 32 ns; gate charge Qg = 64 nC at Vgs = 10 V. Use this loss model: P_cond = Iout^2 * Rds(Tj) (the two FETs together conduct the full output current), P_sw = 0.5 * Vin * Iout * (tr + tf) * fsw, P_gate = 2 * Qg * Vgs * fsw, P = P_cond + P_sw + P_gate. Efficiency eta = Pout / (Pout + P) with Pout = Vout * Iout.

Both FETs share one heat sink: Tj = Ta + P * (RthJC + RthCS + Rsa), with RthJC = 0.65 C/W, RthCS = 0.34 C/W, Ta = 50 C inside the enclosure. Note Rds depends on Tj, so solve the thermal loop self-consistently. Rsa depends on the air velocity v through the sink; interpolate linearly between the catalog points and clamp outside them. Air velocity v = Q / 3600 / A_duct with A_duct = 0.0076 m2, where Q (m3/h) is the fan operating point: the flow at which the fan's static pressure (interpolate linearly between its curve points) equals the enclosure system curve dP = k * Q^2 with k = 0.0094 Pa/(m3/h)^2. With no fan, v = 0.

Ripple: inductor L = 14.0 uH, output capacitor C = 145 uF, D = Vout / Vin. dI = Vout * (1 - D) / (L * fsw) must not exceed 3.0 A and dV = dI / (8 * C * fsw) must not exceed 50 mV.

Constraints: fsw between 50 and 500 kHz; Tj <= 120 C; eta >= 96.0%; fan noise <= 35 dBA (no fan = 0 dBA); heat sink height <= 60 mm; heat sink price + fan price <= 18.

Heat sink catalog:
  HS-1: Rsa = 12.18 / 6.09 / 4.26 / 3.04 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 15 mm, price 1.82
  HS-2: Rsa = 8.12 / 4.06 / 2.84 / 2.03 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 25 mm, price 4.20
  HS-3: Rsa = 5.58 / 2.64 / 1.83 / 1.32 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 35 mm, price 7.77
  HS-4: Rsa = 3.86 / 1.83 / 1.27 / 0.91 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 45 mm, price 12.10
  HS-5: Rsa = 2.64 / 1.22 / 0.86 / 0.61 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 60 mm, price 16.38
  HS-6: Rsa = 1.83 / 0.86 / 0.61 / 0.46 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 80 mm, price 27.26

Fan catalog (or use no fan):
  FAN-A (40x40x10 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 30.4], [7.6, 18.3], [12.2, 9.1], [15.2, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 28 dBA, price 2.55
  FAN-B (60x60x25 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 45.7], [20.3, 27.4], [32.5, 13.7], [40.6, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 32 dBA, price 6.84
  FAN-C (80x80x25 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 40.6], [35.5, 24.4], [56.8, 12.2], [71.0, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 30 dBA, price 7.36
  FAN-D (80x80x38 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 91.3], [55.8, 54.8], [89.3, 27.4], [111.6, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 42 dBA, price 14.98
  FAN-E (92x92x38 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 111.6], [81.2, 67.0], [129.9, 33.5], [162.4, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 46 dBA, price 19.19

Any design satisfying every constraint passes. Return {"fsw_hz": <number>, "heatsink": "<id>", "fan": "<id>" or null}.
